about: Lanterns in /images/hero-lanterns.jpg, measured on an 800 x 1200 copy: centre x, centre y, half width, half height of the paper ball, and the lowest point of the tassel. Every lantern swings around a point above its centre; its exact edge comes from scripts/assets/hero-lanterns-cut.png, and these outlines decide which lantern owns each cut pixel (scripts/cut-lanterns.py). Front lanterns swing furthest. Nearest first, so a pixel two lanterns could claim goes to the nearer one.
